title: Width after selecting first-layer terms
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $C$ be a depth circuit on $n$ coordinates, and select any finite set of indices of its first-layer gates. The width of the DNF consisting of the selected gates is at most the width of $C$.
